title: Two Canadian music rights orgs join to streamline royalties
summary: In a move aimed at streamlining music royalties in Canada, leading performing rights organisation SOCAN has acquired the Canadian Musical Reproduction Rights Agency (CMRRA), bringing the country’s two main music rights organisations under one umbrella. With the acquisition from SoundExchange, SOCAN – the Society of Composers, Authors and Music Publishers of Canada – will add mechanical rights administration to its existing performance rights and international royalty services. CMRRA will continue as a standalone unit while benefiting from SOCAN’s resources and network. title: ‘Going to a festival alone is no longer a compromise’
summary: As more individuals go it alone at festivals, Denmark’s Smukfest is expanding its community options for solo festival-goers. Of the 60,000 people expected to attend the long-standing forest festival in Skanderborg this week (2-9 August), roughly 4.5% of them (2,700) will attend on their own. New research from one of Scandinavia’s largest music festivals finds that audiences are increasingly making the choice to attend solo, with nearly 90% of surveyed solo attendees saying they value the freedom of shaping their own experience.
